cohort: 533 women with OF who presented to the Fistula Care Centre at Bwaila Hospital, Lilongwe, Malawi, between September 2011 and July 2014
finding: Multiparity and history of caesarean delivery were associated with an increased risk of developing a high fistula.
mod_finding: Women with a history of caesarean delivery had a higher risk of developing a high fistula.
